_note: Hand-tuned layer on top of the scraped brand.json (thegymking.com, Shopify). Run: python3 tools/build_brand.py --rebuild gymking. No homepage video. Hand-picked images in assets/brand/ are crops of the site's own imagery: hero = the homepage Heritage Collection mobile hero, drop = the Heritage desktop hero, the Women's New In menu image, the Men's Signature and Women's homepage banners, and the Outerwear menu image. Logos are the site's header SVG wordmark (the generator picked a product photo).

scrape._extraCollections: The static nav parse only reached the men's menu; these are the Heritage launch, best sellers and the main women's collections from the rendered menu/homepage.
scrape._namePrefix: Every product title starts with 'Gym King'; the site's product cards show the short name ('Heritage Full Zip Hood').
scrape._skipCollections: Left out so the 900-product cap covers men's and women's categories: the sale lists (362 + 78 styles), the all-women list, and menu edits that overlap the main categories.

name: Gym King
_theme: thegymking.com: white page, #1f1e1f type, warm off-white #f6f5f3 announcement bar and tiles, condensed uppercase display headings ('HERITAGE COLLECTION', 'MEN'S NEW', category tiles) in the theme's 'condensed' face, the theme's 'regular' grotesk for UI and product names (16px regular names, grey 12px colour line, bold prices), white near-square buttons over imagery (2px radius, 12px bold uppercase, 0.9px tracking, arrow), spaced uppercase sub-titles ('GYM KING REIMAGINED'). notes: Free UK standard delivery on orders over £75; free express over £125.

returns.summary: Return within 30 days of delivery, unworn with tags attached, through our returns portal (InPost locker, Post Office or DPD drop-off). A fixed £3.49 charge per order applies; items are refunded, as we don't offer exchanges. Final Sale items and underwear are non-returnable.

_rewards: Gym King runs a real Loyalty Club (thegymking.com/pages/rewards, Yotpo; 'Sign up to Loyalty Club today' in the announcement bar). Earn rates aren't published in the page HTML, so none are quoted; the app's points balance is illustrative.
_discount: The announcement bar offers 20% off your first order (sign-up). The app pop-up mirrors 20% with the placeholder code APP20.

copy.about: Gym King is premium gym clothing, loungewear and activewear designed for both performance and lifestyle, from tracksuits, fleece and borg layers to high-performance gym wear. Rooted in resilience, ambition and community: more than just workout clothing, it's a mindset.
copy.emptyBag: Nothing in here yet. Start with the Heritage Collection or a Twin Set.
copy.heroNotif: Heritage Collection: Gym King reimagined, now live.

_drop: No release date is announced, so the Drops tab demos app early access with the newest collection on the site, the Heritage Collection (homepage hero; products published 14–25 Sep 2026). Previous: Borg Fleece Collection. Date/time is the template's rolling placeholder.

missing: No homepage video: the hero is the site's Heritage Collection campaign image
Loyalty Club is real but its earn rates aren't published in the page, so none are shown; the points balance is illustrative
The site's 20% sign-up code is emailed, not published: APP20 is a placeholder app code

The Sale lists (men's 362, women's 78 styles) and a few overlapping menu edits are left out to keep the app catalogue at about 1,050 products across men's and women's

_instagram: Collected in a browser from the brand's Instagram profile on 2026-10-11 (pinned posts excluded; profile/collaborator-path URLs normalised to /p/<code>/ or /reel/<code>/). Thumbnails: assets/ig/N.jpg, square-cropped, max 600px.
_frameable: thegymking.com allows framing, but inside the in-app browser its own scripts (Grafana Faro, Bing, Shop Pay) throw blocked/402 errors; the in-app browser shows the page summary + 'Open on site' instead, as for brands that can't be framed.
_pages: The FAQs page is only a list of category links (no answers in the HTML), so Help keeps Shipping, Returns and Contact.

DHL: Our DPD deliveries are on a secure PIN delivery service:
When the driver comes to deliver your order you will be asked for a PIN number. This number is unique to each individual order, and is only sent to the person that placed the order. Your PIN number will be sent to you via email and text message by DPD when your order is marked as out for delivery.

What is your returns policy?
Items should be returned within 30 days of delivery, in original saleable condition, unworn, unwashed, with all tags still attached and in original packaging. All items are inspected on return, returns that are refused will be posted back to you.
There is a fixed charge of £3.49 per order payable when you create your return in the return portal.
Please keep your proof of return to allow you/ us to track your parcel and investigate any returns that go missing, without the tracking we are unable to investigate.
For international orders please see the International Returns section below.
Abuse of our Returns Policy (including repeated refunds, free wardrobing and chargeback fraud) will NOT be accepted. Gym King reserves the right to make the final decision on returns and refunds and reserve the right to close a customer account if we deem it necessary.
